summary: We developed an adventure and mystery game called "The Last Walker". In this game, players explore an uninhabited planet after their rocket crashes. They must face challenges, fight against aliens and search for resources to repair their rocket. The main goal is to survive, repair the rocket and escape from the mysterious planet. This project encourages creativity, problem-solving and critical thinking. It is important because it makes learning more interactive, exciting and enjoyable while introducing players to the mysteries of space.
details: My project works by using coding and animation to create an interactive experience about a mystery planet. It helps students learn more about planets, space and their unique characteristics. The project aims to make learning about space more interesting, fun and enjoyable. I used Scratch to develop the project by combining coding, sprites, animations and backgrounds. The creativity of this project comes from designing a unique mystery planet and bringing it to life through animation.
